reason: I'd try the Moro Fizzy or Moro Frappe once to post it, and it's right there for a Thursday-night meetup with friends since it's open till midnight with lots of seats. My weekday coffee stays the free one at the office, though.
objection: I make coffee at the office for free, and on my salary 3.50 to 4 dinars for one iced drink adds up fast, so this can only be a treat, not a habit.
would_change_my_mind: A Thursday-evening deal for groups or a cheaper signature drink around 2.50 would get me coming every week instead of a couple of times a month.
